thread:
Server Backups That Actually Restore: A Practical Guide

Quick thread 🧵
Back up the three things you can't regenerate: your database, user uploads, and config.
Keep them off the server they protect, in object storage.
Automate the schedule, keep a rolling set of versions, and here's the part almost everyone skips: restore one on purpose before you ever need to.
A backup you've never restored is a guess.
